title.narrative: Reduction of GHG Emissions Through Promotion of Investments in Biogas Mini-Grids

description.narrative: Related Project 120327: The activities under the project will augment the usage of biogas technologies for electricity generation in commercial animal farms by converting the methane emitted from animal waste into energy for productive uses in Cambodia. Thus, this Global Environment Facility (GEF)-funded project aims at financing the incremental costs of demonstration and promotion of private investment on biogas-based power generation projects to achieve rural electrification (by displacing diesel generators) for private sector investment sources. Additionally, the project is aimed at addressing key barriers that currently limit the deployment of biogas technology, while simultaneously resulting in a reduction of GHG emissions.
